title: Peunyata Banjir Raya .
intro: ureung nyoe geudong sebagoe pilar daya tahan seulama meuabad-abad, geukheun masyarakat yang hana galak keu cahaya kebenaran wate geuhadapi ejekan dan penolakan Meskipun kemungkinan nyang that rayeuk dan brat that pesan nyang meulangsong keu generasi-generasi, hamba nyoe teutap teuga lam misi awaknyan sampoe dekrit akhe geupeuteubiet.
clues: Lon peuguna sikureung reutoh limong ploh thon keu lon hôi umat lon bak jalan nyang beuna, uroe ngon malam, deungon cara rahsia dan di keu ureueng rame.
Ulôn peuingat umat Ulôn keuhai huköman nyang peudeh, teuma awaknyan jikeubah jaroe-jaroe awaknyan lam geulinyueng dan jitôb droe jih deungon peukayan awaknyan deungon sombong.
Lon geuyue peudong sapeue-sapeue nyang rayeuk that dimiyueb mata Tuhan lon nyang jaga, bahpih hana ie nyang deuh.
Teungoh ulôn keureuja, peumimpén-peumimpén bansa ulôn jijak rot dan jipeuhina ulôn, teuma ulôn peugah ubak awaknyan bahwa hana treb le kamoe kheueh nyang peuhina awaknyan.

Lon meulakèe bak asoe ngon darah lon keudroe mangat meugabong ngon lon, teuma awaknyan jipiléh jimita lindông bak saboh gunong, jipeucaya bahwa gunong nyan teuma jipeuseulamat awaknyan nibak pasang nyang teungoh jiék.
Kapai ulôn akhéjih teuka u Gunong Judi lheueh bumoe jiteubiet ié dan langét hana le jitron ujeuen raya.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
